title: Employee: Parental-leave policy guidance
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Explain the published parental-leave example without deciding whether I qualify or asking for family details.

answer.question: Explain the published parental-leave example without deciding whether I qualify or asking for family details.
answer.answer:
Here's the published example (Sarah Chen synthetic profile):

| Benefit | Details |
|---|---|
| Paternity Leave | 8 weeks fully paid |
| Maternity Leave | 16 weeks fully paid |
| Family Care Stipend | $2,000 one-time |
| Backup Childcare | 6 months included |
| Flexible return-to-work | Available |
| Support | Parent ERG, lactation room access |

Eligibility depends on tenure, location, leave type, and qualifying event — that confirmation has to come from an authorized HR reviewer, not me. This is illustrative policy data only, not a determination for your situation.
